history.sg_progress: The Administration will review the existing key performance indicators before the shift to Umoja Analytics. With the policy revision process now in the final review phase, the focus moving forward is to enhance the operationalization of the accountability framework for the monitoring of decision-making authority in order to improve performance as measured against the strengthened policy framework, for which a key element is more systematically undertaking targeted analysis and follow- up of the monitoring results. The objectives are to: (a) identify systemic issues that can be addressed by better tools, information, guidance and policy or process improvements as the second line of defence; and (b) highlight opportunities for entities to improve their performance against targets as the first line of defence.

history.administration_response: The Business Transformation and Accountability Division has made significant progress in the review of existing delegation of authority key performance indicators by designing a comprehensive approach consisting of mapping the administrative monitoring framework, that is, the internal controls framework identifying risks (based on the findings and recommendations of oversight bodies and the Secretariat’s own analysis formalized in the risk registers) and existing controls (not limited to Business Transformation and Accountability Division controls but applying to all existing controls and monitoring). This is an essential first step to focus delegation of authority key performance indicators on monitoring decision-making only. This mapping of the administrative framework is a phased approach, using a procurement pilot to develop the methodology that is being applied in the other functional areas.
history.board_assessment: Given that the mapping of the administrative framework is a phased approach – Using Procurement pilot to develop the methodology which is being applied in the other functional areas. The Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration conduct a review of the existing key performance indicators to ensure that only those key performance indicators measuring the impact of decisions are used for monitoring delegation of authority before the shift to Umoja Analytics, and conduct more granular and targeted analysis on the priority results of delegation of authority monitoring.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented, given that, as demonstrated to the audit team, the review of the existing key performance indicators has been completed. The Administration has continued its targeted monitoring of and outreach to entities in order to help them to improve their performance. Results from several response mechanism pilots (e.g., Umoja roles requiring authority, human resources exception reporting and performance against the advance purchase policy) have helped to improve the first and second lines of defence and shown positive performance trends in some areas. New monitoring tests and analytical procedures have been developed under the “Response mechanism” initiative, in response to emerging risks and events. This is an area on which the Business Transformation and Accountability Division will continue to focus as part of its continuous improvement approach. Given that this is not time-bound, the Administration requests the closure of the recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the delegation of authority monitoring framework of key performance indicators and analytical procedures has continuously improved in 2024, with successful pilots leading to planned expansions and the identification of priorities for 2025 and beyond, and that the team is making the best possible use of the available capabilities, notwithstanding the challenges faced, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
